item.title: Patch now: Google Brotli: Unchecked Return Value
item.description:
Google Brotli: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 1.0.10, 1.1.1, 1.2.1

First step: Update Google Brotli to the fixed version for your release line (for example 1.0.10, 1.1.1 or 1.2.1).

Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-111497
